note: FICTIONAL scripted legal conversations for the transcription harness (S2.4, D-040). Every person, company and figure is invented. Each scenario lists the entities a transcript must keep and the negated statements it must not flip.

turns.speaker: Helena Marsh
turns.text: Thank you for joining. Harrowgate Systems has sent a redline of the Master Services Agreement dated 2 March 2026.

turns.speaker: Petra Voss
turns.text: What changed on the money side?

turns.speaker: Helena Marsh
turns.text: The monthly fee goes from USD 18,500 to USD 19,750, and the liability cap rises to USD 500,000 under clause 8.1.

turns.speaker: Petra Voss
turns.text: The board said the cap must not fall below USD 400,000, so the cap is fine. We will not accept the fee increase without a longer term.

turns.speaker: Helena Marsh
turns.text: Understood. I will not concede the thirty day convenience notice either. They want sixty days.

negations: We will not accept the fee increase
I will not concede the thirty day convenience notice

turns.speaker: Thomas Reyes
turns.text: Pellucid Holdings expects completion on 15 October 2026, subject to clearance.

turns.speaker: David Okafor
turns.text: Clause 14.2 requires no less than thirty days notice. Your letter of 3 September 2026 gives forty two days, so notice is in time.

turns.speaker: Petra Voss
turns.text: We do not consent to an assignment to any Pellucid affiliate.

turns.speaker: Thomas Reyes
turns.text: There is no assignment. Harrowgate Systems Inc. remains the contracting party.

turns.speaker: David Okafor
turns.text: Then please confirm in writing that the account team will not change.

negations: We do not consent to an assignment
the account team will not change

turns.speaker: Karin Lindqvist
turns.text: Four of the six directors are present, so the meeting is quorate.

turns.speaker: Anders Holm
turns.text: I declare an interest in the Northbridge Analytics project and I will not vote on item five.

turns.speaker: Petra Voss
turns.text: Item three is the Harrowgate renewal. Management asks for authority to negotiate.

turns.speaker: Sofia Berg
turns.text: I move that the liability cap is not reduced below USD 400,000.

turns.speaker: Karin Lindqvist
turns.text: The budget for Project Lantern is SEK 2.4 million for 2026. The board resolves not to propose an interim dividend.

negations: I will not vote on item five
the liability cap is not reduced below USD 400,000

turns.speaker: Helena Marsh
turns.text: When did you first see the invoice for USD 19,750?

turns.speaker: Maria Ek
turns.text: On 1 June 2026, my first day as chief financial officer. I did not approve it.

turns.speaker: Helena Marsh
turns.text: Did anyone at Harrowgate Systems tell you the fee had changed?

turns.speaker: Maria Ek
turns.text: No. Nobody told me, and I never saw a signed amendment.

negations: I never saw a signed amendment
